item.title: Clipboard Sync Without the Cloud in 2026: ClipCascade vs SyncClipboard vs LocalSend
item.description: Every time you copy a password reset link, a customer’s address, or a half-written API key, that string leaves your machine. On macOS it lands in iCloud. On Windows it lands in Microsoft’s cloud clipboard history. On ChromeOS it is synced by default. Nobody asked you, and almost nobody turns it off — which is why clipboard sync is quietly the most invasive convenience feature in modern computing.
